description.sk: Šťavnatá zelenina, olivy a feta – bez varenia.
description.en: Juicy vegetables, olives and feta, no cooking required.

steps.sk: Paradajky nakrájaj na mesiačiky, uhorku na hrubé polkolieska, papriku na prúžky a cibuľu na tenké krúžky.
steps.en: Cut the tomatoes into wedges, the cucumber into thick half-moons, the pepper into strips and the onion into thin rings.

steps.sk: Zeleninu zľahka osoľ, pridaj olivy a premiešaj s olivovým olejom.
steps.en: Lightly salt the vegetables, add the olives and toss with the olive oil.

steps.sk: Navrch polož fetu v jednom kuse, posyp oreganom a podávaj, podľa chuti s chlebom.
steps.en: Place the feta on top in one piece, sprinkle with oregano and serve, with bread if you like.

title.sk: Kuracie souvlaki s tzatziki a ryžou
title.en: Chicken souvlaki with tzatziki and rice

description.sk: Citrónovo-oreganové kura s chladivým tzatziki – výborné do krabičiek.
description.en: Lemon-oregano chicken with cooling tzatziki, great for lunch boxes.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia nakrájaj na kocky a zmiešaj s 2 lyžicami oleja, 2 lyžicami citrónovej šťavy, 2 prelisovanými strúčikmi cesnaku, oreganom, paprikou, soľou a korením. Nechaj 15 minút marinovať.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into cubes and mix with 2 tablespoons of oil, 2 tablespoons of lemon juice, 2 crushed garlic cloves, the oregano, paprika, salt and pepper. Marinate for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Uvar ryžu podľa návodu.
steps.en: Cook the rice according to the packet.

steps.sk: Tzatziki: uhorku nastrúhaj, vytlač z nej vodu a zmiešaj s jogurtom, zvyšným cesnakom, citrónovou šťavou a olejom a s kôprom.
steps.en: Tzatziki: grate the cucumber, squeeze out the water and mix with the yogurt, the remaining garlic, lemon juice and oil, and the dill.

steps.sk: Mäso opekaj na rozpálenej panvici v dvoch dávkach 8 až 10 minút, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zlaté a vnútri bez ružovej farby (74 °C).
steps.en: Fry the chicken in a hot pan in two batches for 8–10 minutes, until golden all over with no pink left inside (74 °C).

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou a tzatziki. V krabičkách vydrží v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Serve with the rice and tzatziki. Keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Vajcia pošírované v korenistej paradajkovo-paprikovej omáčke.
description.en: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.

steps.sk: Na olivovom oleji speň nakrájanú cibuľu a papriku, asi 6 minút.
steps.en: Soften the chopped onion and pepper in the olive oil, about 6 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak, rímsky kmín, papriku a čili a minútu opekaj, kým korenie nezavonia.
steps.en: Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and chili and cook for a minute until fragrant.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky, osoľ a var 8 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 8 minutes until thickened.

steps.sk: Lyžicou urob v omáčke 4 jamky a do každej rozbi vajce. Prikry a var na miernom ohni 5 až 7 minút, kým bielky nestuhnú a žĺtky zostanú mäkké.
steps.en: Make 4 hollows in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook over low heat for 5–7 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft.

steps.sk: Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj priamo z panvice s chlebom.
steps.en: Sprinkle with parsley and serve straight from the pan with bread.

description.sk: Krémový hummus z cíceru v konzerve za 10 minút.
description.en: Creamy hummus from canned chickpeas in 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Cícer sceď, odlož si 4 lyžice nálevu a cícer prepláchni.
steps.en: Drain the chickpeas, keeping 4 tablespoons of the liquid, and rinse them.

steps.sk: V mixéri rozmixuj tahini s citrónovou šťavou, cesnakom, rímskym kmínom a soľou na hustú pastu.
steps.en: Blend the tahini with the lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt into a thick paste.

steps.sk: Pridaj cícer a mixuj 2 až 3 minúty, pričom postupne prilievaš nálev, kým nie je hummus úplne hladký.
steps.en: Add the chickpeas and blend for 2–3 minutes, gradually adding the reserved liquid, until completely smooth.

steps.sk: Pokvapkaj olivovým olejom, posyp paprikou a podávaj s pitou alebo so zeleninou. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with paprika and serve with pita or vegetables. Keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

description.sk: Hodvábne hladká a sýta polievka zo surovín za pár eur.
description.en: A silky smooth, filling soup made from ingredients that cost very little.

steps.sk: Na olivovom oleji speň nakrájanú cibuľu a nastrúhanú mrkvu, asi 5 minút.
steps.en: Soften the chopped onion and grated carrot in the olive oil for about 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj pretlak, rímsky kmín a papriku a krátko opeč.
steps.en: Stir in the tomato paste, cumin and paprika and fry briefly.

steps.sk: Pridaj prepláchnutú šošovicu, bujón a 1,2 l vody a var 20 minút, kým sa šošovica nerozpadne.
steps.en: Add the rinsed lentils, stock cube and 1.2 l water and simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils fall apart.

steps.sk: Polievku rozmixuj dohladka, dochuť soľou a citrónovou šťavou a podávaj posypanú čili vločkami.
steps.en: Blend the soup until smooth, season with salt and lemon juice and serve sprinkled with chili flakes.

title.sk: Kuskusový šalát s cícerom a bylinkami
title.en: Couscous salad with chickpeas and herbs

description.sk: Svieži šalát do krabičky, ktorý zasýti aj bez mäsa.
description.en: A fresh lunch-box salad that fills you up without meat.

steps.sk: Kuskus zalej 250 ml vriacej osolenej vody, prikry a nechaj 5 minút napučať. Potom ho rozpuč vidličkou.
steps.en: Pour 250 ml boiling salted water over the couscous, cover and leave for 5 minutes. Then fluff it with a fork.

steps.sk: Uhorku, paradajky a cibuľu nakrájaj na drobné kocky a bylinky nasekaj.
steps.en: Finely dice the cucumber, tomatoes and onion and chop the herbs.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj kuskus so zeleninou, prepláchnutým cícerom a bylinkami.
steps.en: Mix the couscous with the vegetables, rinsed chickpeas and herbs.

steps.sk: Zalej citrónovou šťavou a olivovým olejom, pridaj rímsky kmín a premiešaj. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Dress with the lemon juice, olive oil and cumin and toss. Keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Mujadara – šošovica s ryžou a karamelizovanou cibuľou
title.en: Mujadara: lentils and rice with caramelised onions

description.sk: Lacná a voňavá klasika Blízkeho východu, úplne rastlinná.
description.en: A cheap, fragrant Middle Eastern classic, fully plant-based.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni a var v 800 ml vody 15 minút, kým nie je napoly mäkká. Vodu nesceďuj.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils and simmer them in 800 ml water for 15 minutes until half-cooked. Do not drain.

steps.sk: Medzitým na oleji na strednom ohni pomaly opekaj cibuľu nakrájanú na tenké polkolieska, kým nie je tmavozlatá a sladká, asi 20 minút. Polovicu odlož.
steps.en: Meanwhile, slowly fry the thinly sliced onions in the oil over medium heat until deep golden and sweet, about 20 minutes. Set half aside.

steps.sk: K šošovici pridaj ryžu, rímsky kmín, škoricu, soľ a polovicu cibule, prikry a var na miernom ohni 18 minút, kým ryža nevsiakne vodu.
steps.en: Add the rice, cumin, cinnamon, salt and half the onions to the lentils, cover and simmer over low heat for 18 minutes until the rice has absorbed the water.

steps.sk: Nechaj 5 minút odpočinúť, okoreň a podávaj posypané zvyšnou cibuľou a petržlenovou vňaťou.
steps.en: Rest for 5 minutes, season with pepper and serve topped with the remaining onions and parsley.

description.sk: Falafel z rúry, chrumkavý bez fritovania, s citrónovou tahini omáčkou.
description.en: Oven-baked falafel, crisp without frying, with lemony tahini sauce.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Cícer, cibuľu, cesnak, petržlen a korenie rozmixuj v sekáčiku nahrubo – nie na pyré.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley and spices in a food processor until coarse, not puréed.

steps.sk: Primiešaj múku, prášok do pečiva, soľ a lyžicu oleja a vytvaruj 16 placiek.
steps.en: Mix in the flour, baking powder, salt and a tablespoon of oil and shape 16 patties.

steps.sk: Poukladaj ich na plech s papierom, potri zvyšným olejom a peč 25 minút, v polovici otoč.
steps.en: Place on a lined tray, brush with the remaining oil and bake for 25 minutes, turning halfway.

steps.sk: Omáčka: tahini rozmiešaj s citrónovou šťavou, štipkou soli a 4 až 5 lyžicami vody do krémova.
steps.en: Sauce: whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, a pinch of salt and 4–5 tablespoons of water until creamy.

steps.sk: Podávaj s omáčkou a pitou.
steps.en: Serve with the sauce and pita.

title.sk: Marocký tagine s cícerom a batátmi
title.en: Moroccan chickpea and sweet potato tagine

description.sk: Sladkokorenistý rastlinný guláš so škoricou a kuskusom.
description.en: A sweet-spiced plant-based stew with cinnamon, served with couscous.

steps.sk: Na oleji speň cibuľu s cesnakom a korením, asi 5 minút.
steps.en: Soften the onion with the garlic and spices in the oil, about 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj batát nakrájaný na kocky, paradajky, nasekané datle, bujón a 300 ml vody a var 20 minút.
steps.en: Add the diced sweet potato, tomatoes, chopped dates, stock cube and 300 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj cícer a var ďalších 5 minút, kým batát nezmäkne.
steps.en: Add the chickpeas and simmer for 5 more minutes until the sweet potato is soft.

steps.sk: Kuskus zalej 250 ml vriacej osolenej vody, prikry na 5 minút a rozpuč vidličkou. Podávaj s tagine a koriandrom.
steps.en: Pour 250 ml boiling salted water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork. Serve with the tagine and coriander.

description.sk: Vrstvy baklažánu, korenistého mäsa a bešamelu, zapečené dozlatista.
description.en: Layers of eggplant, spiced meat and béchamel, baked until golden.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Baklažány nakrájaj na 1 cm plátky, potri 3 lyžicami oleja, osoľ a peč na plechu 20 minút.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Slice the eggplants 1 cm thick, brush with 3 tablespoons of oil, salt and bake on a tray for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji speň cibuľu s cesnakom, pridaj mäso a opekaj, kým nie je bez ružovej farby. Pridaj paradajky, škoricu, oregano a soľ a nechaj 20 minút dusiť.
steps.en: Soften the onion and garlic in the remaining oil, add the beef and brown until no pink remains. Add the tomatoes, cinnamon, oregano and salt and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Bešamel: na masle opraž múku, vmiešaj mlieko a var 5 minút. Stiahni z ohňa a vmiešaj vajce, polovicu syra a muškátový oriešok.
steps.en: Béchamel: cook the flour in the butter, whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes. Off the heat, stir in the egg, half the cheese and the nutmeg.

steps.sk: Rúru stiahni na 180 °C. Vrstvi baklažán, mäso, baklažán a navrch bešamel, posyp zvyšným syrom.
steps.en: Lower the oven to 180 °C. Layer eggplant, meat, eggplant and finish with béchamel; sprinkle with the remaining cheese.

steps.sk: Peč 40 minút dozlatista a pred krájaním nechaj 15 minút odpočinúť.
steps.en: Bake for 40 minutes until golden and rest for 15 minutes before cutting.

description.sk: Hustá rastlinná polievka s olivovým olejom a zeleninou.
description.en: A thick plant-based soup with olive oil and vegetables.

steps.sk: Na olivovom oleji speň nakrájanú cibuľu, mrkvu a zeler, asi 8 minút.
steps.en: Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery in the olive oil, about 8 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj pretlak, paradajky, fazuľu, bobkový list, oregano, soľ a 1 l vody a var 25 minút.
steps.en: Add the tomato paste, tomatoes, beans, bay leaf, oregano, salt and 1 l water and simmer for 25 minutes.

steps.sk: Okoreň a podávaj pokvapkané olivovým olejom, s chlebom.
steps.en: Season with pepper and serve drizzled with olive oil, with bread.

title.sk: Gemista – zelenina plnená ryžou a bylinkami
title.en: Gemista: vegetables stuffed with herbed rice

description.sk: Grécke papriky a paradajky plnené ryžou s mätou a petržlenom, pečené v rúre.
description.en: Greek peppers and tomatoes stuffed with mint and parsley rice, baked in the oven.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Papriky a paradajky zbav vrchnákov, paradajky vydlabaj a dužinu nasekaj.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cut the tops off the peppers and tomatoes, scoop out the tomatoes and chop the flesh.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj surovú ryžu, paradajkovú dužinu, nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, cesnak, bylinky, 3 lyžice oleja, soľ a korenie.
steps.en: Mix the raw rice with the tomato flesh, finely chopped onion, garlic, herbs, 3 tablespoons of oil, salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Naplň zeleninu do troch štvrtín, prikry vrchnákmi a poukladaj do misy. Medzi ne daj mesiačiky zemiakov.
steps.en: Fill the vegetables three-quarters full, replace the tops and arrange in a dish with potato wedges between them.

steps.sk: Zalej passatou zriedenou 200 ml vody, pokvapkaj zvyšným olejom a peč prikryté 40 minút, potom odkryté ešte 30 minút, kým ryža nie je mäkká.
steps.en: Pour over the passata diluted with 200 ml water, drizzle with the remaining oil and bake covered for 40 minutes, then uncovered for 30 more minutes until the rice is tender.

description.sk: Korenisté kuracie stehná s cesnakovým jogurtom, ryžou a šalátom.
description.en: Spiced chicken thighs with garlic yogurt, rice and salad.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na prúžky a premiešaj s olejom, 2 lyžicami citrónovej šťavy, korením, 1 lyžičkou soli a 2 lyžicami jogurtu. Nechaj 15 minút marinovať.
steps.en: Slice the chicken into strips and mix with the oil, 2 tablespoons of lemon juice, the spices, 1 teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of the yogurt. Marinate for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Uvar ryžu. Zvyšný jogurt zmiešaj s prelisovaným cesnakom, citrónovou šťavou a soľou.
steps.en: Cook the rice. Mix the remaining yogurt with the crushed garlic, lemon juice and salt.

steps.sk: Na rozpálenej panvici opekaj mäso 8 až 10 minút, kým nie je na okrajoch chrumkavé a vnútri prepečené (75 °C).
steps.en: Fry the chicken in a hot pan for 8–10 minutes until crisp at the edges and cooked through (75 °C).

steps.sk: Do misiek daj ryžu, mäso, nakrájanú zeleninu a cesnakový jogurt.
steps.en: Fill bowls with rice, chicken, chopped vegetables and garlic yogurt.

description.sk: Libanonský šalát, v ktorom hlavnú úlohu hrá petržlen.
description.en: A Lebanese salad where parsley is the star.

steps.sk: Bulgur zalej 200 ml vriacej vody, prikry a nechaj 15 minút napučať. Rozpuč vidličkou a nechaj vychladnúť.
steps.en: Pour 200 ml boiling water over the bulgur, cover and leave for 15 minutes. Fluff with a fork and let it cool.

steps.sk: Petržlen a mätu nasekaj nadrobno, paradajky a uhorku nakrájaj na malé kocky a cibuľku na kolieska.
steps.en: Finely chop the parsley and mint, dice the tomatoes and cucumber and slice the spring onions.

steps.sk: Všetko zmiešaj s bulgurom, citrónovou šťavou, olejom a soľou.
steps.en: Mix everything with the bulgur, lemon juice, oil and salt.

description.sk: Krémový dip z pečeného baklažánu s tahini a citrónom.
description.en: A creamy dip of roasted eggplant with tahini and lemon.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Baklažány prepichaj vidličkou a peč celé 40 minút, kým úplne nezmäknú a šupka nezuhoľnatie.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Prick the eggplants with a fork and roast them whole for 40 minutes until completely soft and charred.

steps.sk: Nechaj ich vychladnúť, rozkroj a lyžicou vyber dužinu. Nechaj ju 5 minút odkvapkať v sitku.
steps.en: Let them cool, halve them and scoop out the flesh. Drain it in a sieve for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Roztlač vidličkou s tahini, citrónovou šťavou, cesnakom, rímskym kmínom a soľou.
steps.en: Mash with a fork with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt.

steps.sk: Pokvapkaj olivovým olejom a podávaj s pitou.
steps.en: Drizzle with olive oil and serve with pita.

title.en: Harira: Moroccan lentil and chickpea soup

description.sk: Korenistá polievka so zázvorom, škoricou a bylinkami.
description.en: A spiced soup with ginger, cinnamon and herbs.

steps.sk: Na oleji speň nakrájanú cibuľu a zeler, pridaj korenie a pretlak a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Soften the chopped onion and celery in the oil, add the spices and tomato paste and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, prepláchnutú šošovicu, bujóny a 1,5 l vody a var 25 minút.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, rinsed lentils, stock cubes and 1.5 l water and simmer for 25 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj cícer a polovicu byliniek a var ešte 10 minút.
steps.en: Add the chickpeas and half the herbs and simmer for 10 more minutes.

steps.sk: Dochuť citrónovou šťavou a podávaj posypané zvyšnými bylinkami.
steps.en: Finish with lemon juice and serve sprinkled with the remaining herbs.
